mcp_tools.name: forecast_with_ranges_and_scorecard
mcp_tools.title: Forecast with ranges and scorecard
mcp_tools.description: Submit a declared forecast artifact (purpose and horizon, baselines, range, triggered scenarios, and a forecast-vs-actual scorecard history); get a deterministic FORECAST_READY / FORECAST_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed range-ordering, scenario-trigger and scorecard-metric re-derivation checks, with per-check evidence. Validates a declared forecast; it does not produce one.

inputSchema.description: The forecast artifact manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

forecast.description: Forecast purpose, horizon and ownership evidence.

baselines.description: Baseline values and comparison evidence (naive / moving-average / seasonal-naive).

scenarios.description: Declared scenarios covering base / best / worst.

scorecard.description: Scorecard with forecast-vs-actual history and declared MAE / MAPE / bias.

revision.description: Revision-hygiene evidence (history preserved, no silent restatement).

expect.notes: computed_spot_checks: MAE=0.0, MAPE=0.0, Bias=0.0. Range 90 <= 100 < 110 holds.
